boundary.text: Above $40,000 a year, you can no longer apply for help with heating bills in Texas. It is called LIHEAP. It is worth $1,200 a winter if you get it. Fewer than 1 in 10 families who could get it here do. If you get it, turn it on to see it in your line.

Waits Your kids' free state health plan would end. It is called Medicaid. It does not end that day.
